correctness.rationale: The source's flat count blocks have the stated Hilbert–Schmidt masses and ranks. Keeping all low-difference blocks matches their total retained mass at polynomial rank overhead. For the other direction, the high-difference operator norm estimate or the stronger published retained-weight inequality gives the upper profile. The binomial central limit theorem and continuous inversion yield the curve and the fixed-error coefficient.
residual_risks: The given finite gate checks do not prove the source's all-time block theorem. The result uses that theorem and applies only at the specified cut and for fixed rank exponent or fixed error.
